# Chantal Mental Health Counseling

> Online therapy (secure video) for children (6+), teens and adults anywhere in New York State, with Chantal Amoussou, LMHC-D, CASAC, ADHD-CCSP, a Licensed Mental Health Counselor in New York. Sessions in English, French and Mina; couples counseling and sessions in Haitian Creole with a clinician on her team.

- Credentials: LMHC-D (New York); CASAC (New York); ADHD-Certified Clinical Services Provider; certified in anger management; Master's in Mental Health Counseling (Long Island University, Brooklyn); MPH.
- LGBTQ+ affirming care: LGBTQ+ clients are welcome.
- Ages: 6 and up. Clients under 18 start care with a parent or guardian. Couples counseling available with a clinician on her team (self-pay, $200 per session, English or Haitian Creole). No medication prescribing.
- Format: online only (telehealth) for clients located in New York State. No in-person office.
- Hours (Eastern): Monday to Friday 7 am to noon and 4 to 10 pm; Saturday and Sunday 7 am to 9 pm. Sessions of 30 or 53 minutes.
- Fees: self-pay $200 per session.
- Insurance accepted: Aetna, Carelon, Cigna, Curative, Fidelis Care, First Health, Medicare, Optum, Oxford, Tricare East. Coming soon: New York Medicaid. Coverage is confirmed before the first session.
- Phone: (516) 614-4116 (answered 24/7 by a virtual assistant who takes callback requests)
- Email: chantal@chantalmentalhealth.com (please do not send health details by email)
- Request an appointment: https://chantalmentalhealth.com/request-appointment/
- Crisis: this practice is not for emergencies. Call or text 988, or call 911 if in immediate danger.

## Services
- [Immigration evaluations](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/immigration-evaluations/): Psychosocial evaluations for Asylum, VAWA, U Visa, T Visa and extreme hardship waiver cases, for individuals and attorneys (referral form on the page). $1,500 flat fee, rush report +$300, report within 14 days of the final interview. English, French or Mina, by secure video.
- [Trauma & domestic violence](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/trauma-domestic-violence/): Trauma-informed support for survivors of domestic violence, trauma and PTSD.
- [Mental health assessments](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/assessments/): Diagnostic, depression, anxiety, trauma and substance use assessments, with treatment recommendations.
- [Anxiety](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/anxiety/): Worry, racing thoughts and tension that get in the way of daily life.
- [Depression](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/depression/): Low mood, loss of interest and feeling stuck, with steady support to move forward.
- [ADHD](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/adhd/): Focus, organization and follow-through, for children, teens and adults.
- [Substance use](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/substance-use/): Support for changing your relationship with alcohol or drugs, from a CASAC.
- [Anger management](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/anger-management/): Understand what sets you off and respond in ways you feel good about.
- [Children & teens](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/children-teens/): Therapy for ages 6 to 17, with parents involved along the way.
- [Bipolar disorder](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/bipolar/): Tools to understand mood shifts, build routines and stay steady.
- [OCD](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/ocd/): Practical, evidence-based strategies for intrusive thoughts and compulsions.
- [Stress](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/stress/): Work, family and life transitions, with space to breathe and regroup.
- [Couples counseling](https://chantalmentalhealth.com/services/couples-counseling/): Communication, conflict and reconnecting, with a clinician on Chantal's team, in English or Haitian Creole. Self-pay $200 per session.
